title: Qwack
description: What if there was an app that paid you while you socialized with others? Presenting Qwack! Now chat anonymously with people across the globe. We offer text and video chat, along with hypercasual games to help you find new people around the globe.
how_its_made: We ran into state management issues with react and livepeer resulting in the video not working. Maintaining quality of video stream. Figuring out the tokenomics for the app. Creating a modular framework which would enable any web2 app compatible with token rewards.
